description: `PlayerInputModeServiceClient` converts local InputMode activity into one of three public control families:

PlayerInputModeServiceClient.luau.description: Selects the local player's active control family, reports it to the server over ByteNet, and exposes every player's replicated input-mode attribute. Public entry points include `PlayerInputModeServiceClient.Init`, `PlayerInputModeServiceClient.Start`, `PlayerInputModeServiceClient.ObservePlayerInputType`, `PlayerInputModeServiceClient.GetPlayerInputModeType`, `PlayerInputModeServiceClient.GetSelector`,…

Shared/PlayerInputModeNetwork.luau.description: ByteNet protocol used to report the local player's selected input mode to the server. The payload is one uint8; the server validates the code before setting the replicated Player attribute.

Shared/PlayerInputModeServiceConstants.l.description: Constants shared by PlayerInputModeService and its client.

Shared/PlayerInputModeTypes.luau.description: Input-mode values exposed on Player attributes.

Shared/PlayerInputModeUtils.luau.description: Utilities for reading, observing, and encoding the input mode replicated on a Player attribute. Public entry points include `PlayerInputModeUtils.getPlayerInputModeType`, `PlayerInputModeUtils.observePlayerInputModeType`, `PlayerInputModeUtils.getPlayerInputModeAsync`, `PlayerInputModeUtils.isInputModeType`, `PlayerInputModeUtils.setPlayerInputModeType`, `PlayerInputModeUtils.toNetworkCode`,…
